answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, with the bond burned if peers prove fake activity. One identity is cheap, but a sybil farm must fund each pigment-stamped account separately, so cost scales linearly while reputation grows only with verified work. Like a plume of smoke betraying a hidden fire, correlated deposits reveal clusters, and one bad actor's ripple of forfeited bonds makes mass fakery unprofitable.
